verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into an up Counter Strike; you win if you poke with Q and only close in once it's down.

brief.thesis: Jax has zero ranged poke, so Dr. Mundo's Q (Infected Cleaver, 975 range, 4s cooldown, max-health damage) lets him chip Jax for free from outside auto range. The entire lane hinges on respecting the 300-range threat of Jax's E (Counter Strike) — walk into it and he dodges your autos then stuns and punishes; wait it out and you get a free window to all-in.

theirWindow.what: He will bait an auto, dodge it, then stun and follow with an Empowered (W) strike. Do not trade in melee here — throw Q from range instead.

yourWindow.when: right after Jax uses Counter Strike
yourWindow.what: It's down for 18/16/14/12/10s depending on rank — step in and chain Q, Burning Agony (W) ticks, and autos since he has no stun to punish you with.

start.why: Blunts Jax's auto-attack harass and Empowered pokes while you wait for Q poke windows to open up.

boots.why: The extra movement speed lets you stay just outside the 300-range Counter Strike threat while still landing Q.

core.why: Max-health stacking directly scales your Q damage and buys time for Adrenaline Rush to heal you back up between trades.
More max health for the same reason, plus stacking damage that rewards surviving extended auto exchanges with Jax.
Adds flat damage and a max-health-scaling proc so your trades keep hurting even once you're a wall of health.

you're getting outsustained or need the grievous wounds component early
the enemy team adds meaningful magic damage and you need the heal amp with warmog's

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the max-health stacking build and heals you every proc, letting you win the slow war of attrition against Jax's all-in windows.

summoners.why: Flash gives you an out if Jax lands Leap Strike into Counter Strike; Teleport lets you keep poking and resetting without losing wave control, the highest win-rate combo at 56.7%.

playing.title: Spam Q on cooldown
playing.detail: At a 4s cooldown and 975 range, Infected Cleaver should hit Jax almost every time it's up — he has nothing to answer it with at range.

playing.title: Never auto-trade into an up E
playing.detail: If Jax's Counter Strike is available, he dodges your attacks and stuns you for free. Stay at Q range until it's spent.

playing.title: Punish the Counter Strike cooldown window
playing.detail: Once he uses E, it's down for 18/16/14/12/10s by rank — close in immediately and chain Burning Agony (W) ticks plus autos.

playing.title: Use W to cut the stun short
playing.detail: Burning Agony reduces disable duration, so if you do get caught by Counter Strike, the stun on you will be shorter than expected.

playing.title: Save Sadism for skirmishes, not just all-ins
playing.detail: Sadism's movement speed and regen let you out-sustain or disengage from Jax's Relentless Assault stacking in a prolonged fight.

playing.title: Watch for his third-hit R stacks
playing.detail: Relentless Assault has no cooldown and deals bonus damage on every third consecutive attack — don't stand in extended auto-exchanges and eat repeated procs.

playing.title: Rush the health-stacking core
playing.detail: Warmog's into Heartsteel into Titanic Hydra scales your Q damage and turns you into a wall Jax can't burst through late.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample figures are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the tactical reasoning around E timing and poke windows is my own read of the kit.

stats.opponentTip: Do not stand in range of (Q) when Jax is using (E). Use [Q] to create some distance! Close in to fight when (E) is on cooldown.
